items.title: 23.5 Reactions of Carboxylic Acids (carboxylic acids ke reactions) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 23.5, printed pages 107-108 (PDF 110-111).

blocks.text: Carboxylic acids ke reactions ko in types (qismon) mein divide kiya ja sakta hai:

items: Woh reactions jin mein sirf acidic hydrogen (H⁺ dene wala H) hissa leta hai.
Woh reactions jin mein –OH group kisi aur group se badal jata hai.
Woh reactions jin mein poora carboxyl group (–COOH) hissa leta hai.
